title: MELD-DNA: A new tool for capturing protein-DNA binding
one_liner_zh: 该文提出MELD-DNA计算工具，利用物理模拟方法预测蛋白-DNA复合物结构并采样结合模式，直接聚焦TF-DNA结合与互作机制建模，高度匹配课题。
abstract: Herein we present MELD-DNA, a novel computational approach to address the problem of protein-DNA structure prediction. This method addresses well-known issues hampering current computational approaches to bridge the gap between structural and sequence knowledge, such as large conformational changes in DNA and highly charged electrostatic interaction during binding. MELD-DNA is able to: i) sample multiple binding modes, ii) identify the preferred binding mode from the ensembles, and iii) provide qualitative binding preferences between DNA sequences. We expect the results presented herein will have impact in the field of biophysics (through new software development), structural biology (by complementing DNA structural databases) and supramolecular chemistry (by bringing new insights into protein-DNA interactions).
abstract_zh: 在此，我们提出MELD-DNA，一种新颖的计算方法，旨在解决蛋白质-DNA结构预测问题。该方法针对当前计算方法中阻碍结构与序列知识之间桥梁的已知难题，如DNA的大构象变化及结合过程中的高电荷静电相互作用。MELD-DNA能够：i) 采样多种结合模式，ii) 从集合中识别出优先结合模式，iii) 提供DNA序列间的定性结合偏好。我们预期本文所呈现的结果将在生物物理学领域（通过新软件开发）、结构生物学领域（通过补充DNA结构数据库）以及超分子化学领域（通过为蛋白质-DNA相互作用带来新见解）产生影响。
